_comment: Originating network or studio only when BRYME's own catalogue copy or an official studio/network trailer channel already states it. Check links are official homepages labelled Check — never a live catalogue claim. Do not treat a trailer host (IGN, Rotten Tomatoes) as a studio.

shogun.evidence: Catalogue description begins "FX's epic adaptation"; official trailer channel is FX Networks.
shogun.lead: FX originals have typically been offered through the FX / Hulu / Disney+ family, depending on country. That is not a live listing.

house-of-the-dragon.evidence: Official trailer channel is HBO Max.
house-of-the-dragon.lead: HBO originals have typically been offered through Max / HBO in many territories. That is not a live listing.

silo.evidence: Catalogue description calls it "Apple TV+'s brilliant dystopian epic"; official trailer channel is Apple TV.
silo.lead: Search the Apple TV app in your country and confirm the title page on the service itself.

ted-lasso.evidence: Official trailer channel is Apple TV.
ted-lasso.lead: Search the Apple TV app in your country and confirm the title page on the service itself.

inside-out-2.evidence: Catalogue description and official trailer channel are Pixar.
inside-out-2.lead: Pixar films are often later offered through the Disney family of licensed services. That is not a live listing.

toy-story-5.lead: This title may still be in theatrical or pre-release windows. Confirm on licensed services; do not assume a stream exists yet.
